Maria (Sales): Closed deal: NovoHealth (mid-market). Contract signed today for private deployment + 12mo commit. Key constraints: HIPAA, EU data residency, SSO (Okta), initial throughput: 50 qps gen, peak 200/day, embedding use for search.
Jamal (CSM): Congrats! I'll lead onboarding. Can we get the final SOW + contact at customer for network team?
Maria (Sales): attaching SOW link: https://redwood/drive/sow_novo_2026.pdf. Primary contact: alex@novo.co, infra lead: priya@novo.co. Legal asked for KBA by EOD.
Tara (CS Ops): I'll create the onboarding runbook and add owners. Will track provisioning windows. Prefer kickoff Wed 10am PT — ok?
Sophie (Support): Adding support intake: need to know whether they want Private VPC or on-prem. Also confirm KMS/HSM requirements.
Jamal (CSM): They requested Private VPC with customer-managed KMS. Renewal risk: early signal — they negotiated high discount and asked for quarterly ROI check-ins. Tag as 'renewal-watch'.
Liam (Eng): For Private VPC + HIPAA we'll need ticket to eng for network peering and domain allowlist. What's target go-live date?
Maria (Sales): Target is pilot in 4 weeks, GA in 10 weeks. They've allocated staging infra now.
Liam (Eng): I'll open ENG-7842: NovoHealth private deploy prep (peering, certs, KV rotation). Pinged eng-oncall. ETA initial assessment 48h.
deploy-bot: Deployment queue item created: DQ-9921 for NovoHealth onboarding. Status: queued.
Sophie (Support): I'll prep runbook template: SSO (Okta SAML), audit log retention, support SLA, escalation path. Need Alex/Priya to approve network maintenance window.
Tara (CS Ops): Action owners:
- Jamal: kickoff + customer comms (owner)
- Tara: runbook + onboarding checklist (owner)
- Sophie: support readiness + playbooks (owner)
- Liam: eng ticket + infra assessment (owner)
- Maria: contract questions + legal followups (owner)
Jamal (CSM): I'll schedule kickoff and send calendar invites, plus a short pre-kick checklist to Alex. Also want a thread to capture feedback after pilot — will create a doc.
Maria (Sales): Thx team. Flags: legal KBA due EOD, billing requires PO within 7 days. I'll chase.
Jamal (CSM): Noted. I'll add 'renewal-watch' tag in CRM and set quarterly ROI reminders.
Liam (Eng): Quick ask — which model family and expected prompt sizes? small/med/long? This affects KV cache sizing.
Jamal (CSM): They'll use rLlama-7b tuned; median prompt ~150 tokens, occasional >1k. I'll confirm.
Sophie (Support): Putting in onboarding ticket: CS-ONB-5592. Will attach runbook once Tara has it.
Tara (CS Ops): Next steps checklist in thread:
1) Legal KBA (Maria) - EOD
2) Create runbook (Tara) - 2 business days
3) Open ENG ticket (Liam) - now
4) Collect SSO certs + network contacts (Alex/Priya) - before kickoff
5) Kickoff meeting (Jamal) - Wed 10am PT
6) Pilot schedule + metrics (Jamal/Tara/Sophie) - define within kickoff
Anything else?
Maria (Sales): Add billing PO reminder.
Jamal (CSM): I'll follow up after kickoff with a three-week status update. :thumbsup:
